messages:
Samira Patel: Heads up — I'm OOO starting Friday midday (leaving Thu 18:00 PT) and noticed the APAC primary shift on Sat covers a 12h gap unless someone pulls in. I tried to swap with Maya but she has a customer-facing demo. Anyone able to cover primary from 00:00-12:00 SGT on Sat? :wave:

Jon Huang: I can take the first 4h (00:00-04:00 SGT) but then I have a hard stop for a personal thing. Will mark as primary for that window.

Maya Fernandez: Sorry — can't swap this weekend. I'm on the demo. Can be secondary for part of the day if needed.

Priya Rao: I can be secondary whole window. If we need to cascade, I can escalate after 06:00 SGT.

incident-bot: @channel Reminder: oncall rotation rules require primary+secondary overlap >=1h for handoff. See runbook: https://confluence.redwood.com/runbooks/oncall-handoff :robot_face:

Elliot Grant: I can fill 04:00-12:00 SGT and do the handoff with Jon at 04:00. So plan would be Jon(00-04) -> Elliot(04-12) with Priya as secondary. Samira, does that cover your gap?

Samira Patel: Yes that covers it, thank you both! Two quick notes: 1) APAC traffic spike retention rule — if latency > 450ms for 5m alert severity to P1. 2) If we hit capacity errors (503s), toggle fallback routing per runbook.

Priya Rao: I'll patch the oncall calendar now and add a note to the handoff doc. Also pinging rotations channel for visibility.

Jon Huang: Leaving a short handoff checklist here so it's easy to follow at 04:00:
```
- Check Prometheus: redwood/api latency and inference-token-utilization
- Verify dedicated pool health in /ops/pools (k8s pods Ready, GPU mem ok)
- If 503 >=3m -> add 10% burst capacity and scale up model-variant xlarge
- If latency spike -> enable KV prefix cache for frequent routes
- Notify infra if disk pressure > 80% on model cache nodes
```

Maya Fernandez: Quick Q — where is the toggle for fallback routing? I couldn't find it last time.

Samira Patel: In console under Routes -> Policies -> Fallback. Shortcut link: https://console.redwood.com/routes/policy/fallback (requires SSO). Also see the fallback policy snippet in runbook.

incident-bot: @Samira Patel added an action: update-oncall-calendar assigned to Priya Rao (due: 1763002000).

Elliot Grant: I'll be primary 04:00-12:00 SGT. Leaving my contact: +1-555-0199. If you page me, please include a short description + last 10m of logs. Example page payload:
```
ALERT: inference-latency-high
service: redwood-api
since: 4m
nodes_affected: 3
sample_log: "2026-03-14T03:55:12Z retx error serving shard-7"
```

Priya Rao: Added calendar entries and updated the handoff doc with the new overlap rules. I also uploaded the quick links to the runbook: https://confluence.redwood.com/runbooks/oncall-handoff#quick-links

Jon Huang: One more thing — if you need to escalate to Dedicated infra, use the paging key DEDICATED-URGENT. That will page the infra rotation and create a channel rm-incident-<ts>.

Samira Patel: Thanks all — really appreciate the rapid responses. I'll leave short notes in the ticketing system for post-shift review. If anything changes, update this thread so it's recorded. :sparkles:

Maya Fernandez: Thanks everyone, and Samira — enjoy your time OOO! :sun_with_face:

incident-bot: Thread closed for edits after 1763005129.
